content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script for the FUNWAVE-TVD spherical composite beach benchmark (BM5) case A. Loads measured/reference data A.mat (L2; provides t and gauge series g4..g10) and seven model station files sta_0001..sta_0007 into n4..n10 (L4-10). Rescales model time by /10 and shifts by shift=265.82 s (L12, L14-23; commented alternative shift 263.82 L13). A no-op loop copies elevation columns onto themselves (L25-33). Converts reference gauges g4..g10 from m to cm over the first 600 samples (L35-43). Applies waterfall stacking offsets in steps of skp=2 cm: gauge pair k gets +(10-k)*skp for n4..n9/g4..g9 (L45-63); n10/g10 offsets commented out (L65-66). Plots all seven pairs overlaid on one axes (subplot calls commented): reference g* in default color vs model n*(:,1),n*(:,2) in red (L69-101). Title 'Case B (H/d=0.0.0378)' (L102), axis [268 295 -1 14] (L103), xlabel 'sec', ylabel 'cm' (L104-105), grid (L106). Commented remnants for ticks and wall gauge (L107-113). No writes.
entities: script variables: n4..n10 @L4-10, shift @L12, i @L14/L25/L35, g4..g10 (from A.mat, rescaled @L36-42), skp @L45; t and g4..g10 originate from A.mat @L2

equations.ref: model time rescale (factor 1/10) and shift (same for n5..n10 L16-21)
reference gauges m to cm over first 600 samples (g5..g10 L37-42)
waterfall offset 6*skp for gauge 4 (5*skp L50, 4*skp L53, 3*skp L56, 2*skp L59, 1*skp L62)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L2, @L4-10; length @L14, @L25; plot @L69, @L71, @L74, @L76, @L79, @L81, @L84, @L86, @L89, @L91, @L94, @L96, @L99, @L101; hold on @L70 etc.; title @L102; axis @L103; xlabel @L104; ylabel @L105; grid on @L106
unresolved: Model time is divided by 10 before shifting (L15-21) -- implies the station files' time column is in 0.1-s units for this case; not documented in the file.

Title says 'Case B (H/d=0.0.0378)' (L102) though the directory is case_A, and the H/d value contains a doubled decimal ('0.0.0378'); model station elevations are plotted in their native units against cm-converted reference data with no *100 conversion (L25-33 is a no-op loop) -- unit consistency cannot be confirmed here.
g-series are rescaled only over their first 600 samples (L35) while plotted in full against t from A.mat; if the series are longer than 600 the tail remains in meters.
Gauge numbering n4..n10 vs station files sta_0001..sta_0007 mapping and the physical gauges 4-10 layout come from the benchmark definition, external to this file.
